topics: Mathematical Modelling of field problems in Engineering
Governing Equations – Discrete and continuous models
General procedure of Finite Element analysis
Formulation of stiffness matrix- one dimensional spring
bar element assembly and solution procedure
Types of coordinate system in FEM
coordinate transformation Plane truss stiffness formulation and its assembly
Derivation of shape functions using polynomial of One-Dimensional bar
Derivation of strain -displacement relation- B matrix- bar, CST and beam element
Element stiffness-bar, beam and CST element
Quadrilateral elements- Serendipity elements Isoparametric formulations

partA.description:
2 Questions from each module.
 Total of 8 Questions, each carrying 3 marks

partB.description:
Each question carries 9 marks.
Two questions will be given from each module, out of which 1 question should be answered.
Each question can have a maximum of 3 sub divisions.

courseOutcomes.description: To understand the governing equations of various physical phenomena and basic procedure of FEM.
To apply the coordinate transformation and formulation of shape functions of various element.
Formulate shape functions and element strain displacement matrix of various element
Evaluate element stress using energy method and study Galekin weight residual formulations
Study the concept of iso parametric elements and analyze iso parametric formulations
